name: AASW student membership
summary: Low-cost AASW student membership for students in accredited social work degrees, with some free student webinars.
key: Student membership costs around $1 a week.
who: Enrolled in an AASW accredited Bachelor of Social Work
how: Upload a certified copy of your student card or other proof of enrolment, then Join Now.

evidence.quote: For around $1 a week, student membership is an investment in your future.
You can become a student member of AASW if you are enrolled in an AASW accredited Bachelor of Social Work.
